description: Just purchased the Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra 16K. Printing shells with resin now.
body: Just a couple of video clips showing the Saturn during operation.
My first prints with resin. This didnt go how i intended it to. The supports were far too dense.

After a bit of research and some more test prints, I finally printed a decent shell. While trying to remove from the build plate, I chipped off the corner of the shell. Overall though, I'm satisfied with the outcome.
Quick check on the build plate for attachment and we are good to start printing.
Fresh filled resin, ready to get this print started.
